scope: Selected RAW IFD Compression metadata and unchanged decoding for the three committed A7C II modes

metadata_regression.cause: Upstream parse_tiff_ifd changes comp=7 to dispatch comp=6 after parsing the Sony lossless JPEG header; the old adapter exposed the mutable dispatch value.
metadata_regression.fix: Retain the original tag in existing per-IFD metadata and carry it with selected RAW IFD metadata; no decode dispatch or pixel arithmetic changes.

linux_arm64_portability_falsification.interpretation: Existing Linux output differs from macOS. Exact hashes are not asserted as a portable default contract. No corrected-Linux result is claimed without rebuilding that addon.

test_falsification.original_compression_getter: Real lossless decoder probe failed: expected7, received6; corrected native build passed while preserving1/32767 and all same-host pixel hashes.
test_falsification.manifest_overwrite: Discarding authored fields made provenance preservation fail with undefined instead of the authored source.
test_falsification.manifest_integrity: Changing the lossless manifest SHA-256 first character made the exact-original integrity test fail; restoring the real digest passed.
test_falsification.non_tiff_getter: Independent review found readers outside apply_tiff have no preserved tag. A C++ probe instantiated the actual PhotoctlLibRaw getter and set its metadata through existing get_internal_data_pointer(): dispatch=32767/tag=0 failed on the tag-only getter and passed after fallback; dispatch=6/tag=7 still returned7. This is getter-selection evidence, not real non-TIFF decode verification.
test_falsification.cli_wrong_width: Returning image.w+1 made the real lossless CLI decode fail: expected1752, received1753.

reproduction: cargo build -p photoctl-image -j1; node scripts/package-native.mjs; bun run typecheck; bunx vitest run apps/cli/src/decoder-libraw.test.ts packages/render/src/decoder.test.ts fixtures/tools/manifest.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
limits: No lossless-M/S, real-drive, headless CIRAW, photographic quality, or cross-platform bitwise-equivalence claim. Fixture provenance and immutable original hashes live in the adjacent per-ARW manifests.
